assets.title: Hindenburg disaster at Lakehurst, 1937
assets.creator: Unknown photographer, 1937
assets.license: Public domain in the United States (published 1937; copyright not renewed)
assets.credit: Photograph: public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
assets.depicts: The German airship Hindenburg, its tail engulfed in a huge ball of flame, hangs nose-up beside the Lakehurst mooring mast as tiny figures run below.
assets.alt_text: The German airship Hindenburg, its tail engulfed in a huge ball of flame, hangs nose-up beside the Lakehurst mooring mast as tiny figures run below.

assets.title: German airship Hindenburg at Lakehurst, New Jersey
assets.creator: Unknown photographer, 1937
assets.credit: US National Archives, NARA 518856. Public domain.
assets.depicts: The Hindenburg standing at the Lakehurst mooring mast, its full length visible against the airfield.
assets.alt_text: The Hindenburg moored to the tall mast at Lakehurst, its long silver hull stretching across the airfield.

assets.title: Interior of the LZ 129 Hindenburg
assets.creator: Unknown photographer, 1936
assets.credit: Nationaal Archief, via Wikimedia Commons. No known restrictions.
assets.depicts: A passenger lounge inside the Hindenburg, with rows of seating and large windows along the wall.
assets.alt_text: The Hindenburg's passenger lounge, rows of seats and long windows along a curved wall.

assets.title: The Hindenburg burning at Lakehurst
assets.creator: Gus Pasquerella, 1937
assets.license: Public domain in the United States
assets.credit: Photograph: Gus Pasquerella, 1937. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.
assets.depicts: The airship engulfed in flame, nose up, with the mooring mast behind it.
assets.alt_text: Flames consume the Hindenburg's hull as the airship hangs nose-up beside the Lakehurst mast.

assets.title: Airship Hindenburg disaster, 6 May 1937 (US Navy photograph)

assets.creator: US Navy, 1937
assets.depicts: The wreck of the Hindenburg on the ground at Lakehurst, seen shortly after the fire.
assets.alt_text: The burnt framework of the Hindenburg collapsed on the airfield at Lakehurst, seen from a distance.
